name: WearThis
description: Open the trade window so the player can hand clothes to wear; the NPC keeps them as an outfit.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow and Wait.
prompt: If the player wants to give you clothes or armor to wear, or asks you to change into something they hand you, begin your response with '{key}:'
